parsed.explanation: The deduction of (4) from equality of small-prime supports is logically valid only after (3). But (3)'s forward implication relies wholly on the lemma that every term’s small-prime support is good, whose proof is replaced by “details omitted.” The later reference to an Rp^k construction does not supply that construction or prove it for all terms. Thus unconditional periodicity from A is not established; a full large-prime-erasure lemma is required.
